gloss: replacement; swap; changing (one attached part for another)

definitions.gloss: replacement; swap; changing (one attached part for another)
definitions.explanation: The act of removing a part, fitting, accessory, or attachment and putting a different one in its place. Used for items that are meant to be installed and removed, such as light fixtures, phone cases, name tags, straps, and belts. Distinct from pure replacement ({交換|こうかん}) in that the item is physically attached/detached.

examples.japanese: ⟦バンド→バンド：05508_bando⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{替|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧だ。
examples.english: The band is easy to swap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名札|なふだ}→名札：12338_nafuda⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{替|か}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please change out the name tag.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ベルト→ベルト：01508_beruto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{替|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}えられる→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: You can swap out the strap on this watch, so you can change its look based on your mood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{替|か}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧だ。
examples.english: It is safer to ask a contractor to replace the lighting fixtures.

notes:
The noun form of {付|つ}け{替|か}える (to swap / replace by reattaching), from ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach) + ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ (to change). Emphasizes the physical act of detaching one thing and attaching another.

USAGE:
- Used for items designed to be attached and detached — straps, covers, cases, fittings, fixtures, tags, etc.
- Often appears in product descriptions for items where swappability is a feature: interchangeable watch bands, modular furniture, camera lenses.
- Compare with simple ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧ (exchange, replacement), which is more general and may not involve attachment/detachment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {付|つ}け{替|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧: easy to swap out
- {付|つ}け{替|か}え⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: swappable / replaceable
- ⟦ベルト→ベルト：01508_beruto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{替|か}え: strap replacement
- ⟦パーツ→パーツ：11272_paatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}け{替|か}え: parts replacement
- {付|つ}け{替|か}え⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: (adjective form) for replacement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧: exchange, swap — broader, includes transactional exchanges and part replacements
- {取|と}り{替|か}え: replacement, swap — near synonym, slightly more general
- {差|さ}し{替|か}え: replacement (by inserting) — used for things that slide or insert, like document pages
- {張|は}り{替|か}え: re-covering / re-papering — used for things that are glued on, like shōji paper or upholstery
